authorization.note: This contract prepares a later instrumented matrix-capture study; it does not authorize a new solve or FEM run.

data_inventory.interpretation: The archives contain matrix dimensions and nonzero counts, not matrix entries. Preload residual histories do not reconstruct the converged displacement vector.

model_and_sign_convention.supports: UX, UY and UZ fixed at x=0
model_and_sign_convention.reported_signed_critical_load: negative compression; archived factor lambda is positive
model_and_sign_convention.pencil: Q(lambda) = K0 + lambda * Kg; lambda is the positive dimensionless load multiplier
model_and_sign_convention.K0_definition: Reduced tangent from assembly.assemble(zero displacement) on the exact registered free-DOF map.
model_and_sign_convention.Kg_definition: Reduced initial-stress second-Piola geometric tangent from assembly.geometric_tangent(u_pre), using the converged proportional-preload state.
model_and_sign_convention.solver_source: LinearBucklingSolver.solve assembles K0 at zero and Kg at its converged preload displacement; diagnostic generalized problem is (K0 + lambda*Kg) phi = 0.

capture_plan.method: Add a development-only observer around the existing solver call. Wrap solve_full_newton to archive the returned u_pre, and wrap the exact assembly.assemble(zero) and assembly.geometric_tangent(u_pre) calls to capture CSR matrices without changing returned values or production algorithms.
capture_plan.attempts: One attempt per source, with separate new registered scopes and ledgers; no retry under a consumed scope.
capture_outputs: u_pre vector and constrained/free DOF map
K0 and Kg in canonical CSR arrays with dtype, shape, symmetry defect and SHA-256
source, input, mesh and assembly-module identities
solver status, preload diagnostics and comparison against the archived factor and residual
invariants: same model builder, mesh, material, supports, loads, four preload increments, preload factor 1.0 and tolerances as the archived attempts
instrumentation must return the same arrays and solver results as the uninstrumented path
no changes to buckling algorithms, thresholds or historical evidence

proposed_budgets.budget_note: These are proposed runner limits; RSS, process and storage polling remain soft observations.

numerical_observation: Check matrix dimensions, finite entries, symmetry defect, free-DOF ordering, units and sparse structure before any spectral claim.
Use dense symmetric factorization/eigensolution on these 276x276 and 300x300 reduced matrices as a practical double-precision screen.
Report backward residuals, conditioning and all eigenvalues in the candidate cluster; label these as numerical observations only.

positivity_of_k0.screen: Smallest-algebraic eigenvalue plus residual and scale-aware error estimate; ordinary floating-point Cholesky/LDL is a screen, not a certificate.
positivity_of_k0.error_controlled: Use outward-rounded interval Cholesky or pivoted interval LDL^T/inertia on the exact captured binary64 entries. This certifies the inertia of the stored matrix. To bound finite-element assembly roundoff as well, propagate interval bounds through element assembly; otherwise describe the result only as an error-controlled property of the captured matrix, not the exact real-arithmetic FE operator. Declare K0 positive definite only when all certified pivots/eigenvalue lower bounds are strictly positive.
positivity_of_k0.failure_status: If a pivot interval contains zero, or the verified backend cannot certify the sign, report K0_POSITIVITY_INDETERMINATE; do not infer positivity from a small residual.

pencil_inertia_and_first_positive_root.transformation: After K0 is certified SPD, form L with K0 = L L^T and S = L^-1 (-Kg) L^-T. Then Q(lambda) is congruent to I - lambda*S; positive roots are reciprocals of positive eigenvalues of S.
pencil_inertia_and_first_positive_root.verification: Certify inertia of Q(lambda) at zero and on both sides of a re-isolated candidate interval using verified symmetric LDL^T/inertia. For lambda >= 0 and certified symmetric S, negative inertia is nondecreasing; n_-(0)=0, n_-(lambda_low)=0 and n_-(lambda_high)=1 establish a single first positive crossing in the interval. Recheck this relation from captured matrices; archived brackets alone are not proof.
pencil_inertia_and_first_positive_root.multiple_roots: An inertia jump greater than one or a clustered positive eigenvalue of S is a multiple/near-multiple root. Report its multiplicity/subspace and do not label one vector as the unique first mode.
pencil_inertia_and_first_positive_root.near_zero_pivots: Use scale-aware outward error intervals; if any pivot interval straddles zero, raise working precision (proposed 128 then 256 bits) and repeat the same matrix-only factorization. If still unresolved, retain INDETERMINATE.
pencil_inertia_and_first_positive_root.nonconvergence: Preserve solver, factorization or interval-eigensolver nonconvergence as NOT_ESTABLISHED; no fallback status may promote the first-mode claim.

mode_comparison.availability: Candidate vectors are archived but belong to different full-DOF spaces (351 and 375 entries) and different meshes.
mode_comparison.method: After candidate eigenspaces are isolated, reconstruct each exact mesh and evaluate vector fields elementwise on a common physical quadrature. Compare volume-weighted L2 projections and principal angles of candidate subspaces, with sign and scale invariance.
mode_comparison.limits: Record uncovered/multiply covered points and the historical mesh's disconnected components. Shape similarity is descriptive and cannot establish eigenvalue rank.

evidence_tiers.NUMERICAL_OBSERVATION: Double-precision results with residuals and conditioning; not an error-controlled proof.
evidence_tiers.ERROR_CONTROLLED_MATRIX_EVIDENCE: Verified signs/inertias for the captured binary64 matrices under explicit factorization bounds; only an assembly-level certificate additionally bounds element-assembly rounding. Neither establishes continuum or physical validity.
evidence_tiers.FIRST_MODE_ESTABLISHED: Permitted only after certified K0 positivity, a verified first positive root/multiplicity count, and a residual-qualified candidate subspace.

stop_conditions: Source, mesh, input or assembly hash differs from the archived scope.
Captured preload does not converge or its exact input/DOF map differs.
K0 or Kg is not symmetric within a predeclared assembly error bound.
K0 positivity or inertia signs remain indeterminate after precision escalation.
Candidate root is outside the archived seed interval and no separately approved contract covers that change.
A multiple-root cluster cannot be isolated or the eigensolver fails its residual contract.
next_step: Select and test a verified interval-inertia backend, implement the two exact capture nodeids, register separate scopes/ledgers after explicit Owner authorization, then perform capture and matrix-only analysis. Until then, FIRST_MODE_NOT_ESTABLISHED remains for both cases.
